rationale: Gem colour naming differs between guides. gf1#9 lists 'Purple/Blue = 5 Gems' and 'Pink = 25 Gems'; gf2#3 calls the 25-value gem purple ('the rare purples worth 25'); gf3#4 (Pink 25), gf4#6 (Blue 5, Magenta 25) agree with gf1's values. Same game gems, different colour words: in gf1 facts 'purple gem' means the 5-value blue gem. Writers must give values, e.g. 'blue gem (5)' and 'pink gem (25)'. 'Purple gem' is deliberately not aliased in 05_aliases.json.

gf2 calls the 25-value gem 'purple'; gf1 (Pink = 25), gf3 (Pink 25) and gf4 (Magenta 25) call it pink/magenta. Same gem, different colour word; value 25 agrees across all four guides. In gf2 facts 'purple gem' means the 25-value gem.

gf1's 'purple/blue = 5' is the blue gem (gf2 'blue sapphires worth 5', gf3 Blue 5, gf4 Blue 5). Values agree; only gf1's extra colour word 'purple' differs from gf2's use of 'purple' for the 25-value gem.

Gnasty Gnorc takes two flames in total. gf2#44: flaming him on the platform makes him 'run away into the room on the right', then on the final ledge 'you can simply flame him and he'll die off'; checklist-enemies#14: 'Then flame him again and YOU BEAT THE GAME!'. gf3-37-12 and gf4-30-18 ('flame him once') describe only the final, finishing flame after the chase, so they do not contradict gf1's 'Flame twice'.
Describes the finishing flame once Spyro reaches Gnasty at the end of the chase; the earlier platform flame (gf2-44-2) makes him flee. Consistent with gf1-132-6 (two flames total).
'Flame him once to knock him out' refers to the final cornered flame in the last room; consistent with gf1-132-6 and gf2-44-2/gf2-44-13 (one flame on the platform, one to finish).

Toasty takes three flames: checklist-enemies#1 'Toasty takes 3 hits to kill'; gf2#8 first flame makes him run, second burns away the outfit, a final quick flame finishes him; gf3#11 sheep revealed after the second flame. 'Quick flame' / 'walk up while flaming' facts describe individual hits, not a different total.
Blowhard takes three flames: gf3-23-2/23-3/23-4 (flamed once he moves on, flamed again he flies off, third flame kills him). gf2-23-11 and checklist-enemies-6-28 describe the final hit only.

Doctor Shemp: three back flames (gf1) matches checklist-enemies#3 'Dr. Shemp takes 3 hits' and gf3/gf4's three-platform/three-ledge sequence. The 'drops purple gem' (gf1, 5-value in gf1's colour naming) / 'golden gem' / 'yellow jewel' facts are per-hit drops, not competing claims.

Not a conflict: Gnasty's World dragons reuse names of earlier dragons. gf2#40: 'all the dragons here are rebels from the five dragon homes'; gf1#120 heads the Gnorc Cove entry 'LATEEF (AGAIN)'. Lateef is freed in both Dream Weavers Home (gf1-141-22) and Gnorc Cove (gf1-143-2, gf3-35-4 'Dragon 76/80 Lateef').

Repeated dragon name: Tomas is freed in Artisans Home (gf2-4-1, cave near the Town Square portal) and again in Gnorc Cove (gf1#120 'You'll re-find Tomas just after the second ship'; gf3-35-5 'Dragon 77/80 Tomas').

Repeated dragon name: Magnus appears in Peace Keepers Home (gf1-44-18 by the balloonist, gf4-11-29 near Gosnold) and again as the last Gnorc Gnexus dragon, freed after Gnasty Gnorc is beaten (gf1-118-4, gf2#40 'beat Gnasty Gnorc ... and after that, free Magnus').

Repeated dragon name: Delbin is freed in Artisans Home (gf2-4-4, by the pond with six pads) and again at the Gnorc Gnexus entrance (gf2#40 'You might remember him from the Artisan home'; gf3-34-2 'Dragon 75/80 Delbin').
Repeated dragon name: Cleetus is freed in Beast Makers Home (gf1-140-25, gf2-25-15, gf4-20-8) and again in Twilight Harbor (gf1-143-8, gf3-36-4 'Dragon 79/80 Cleetus').
Repeated dragon name: Cosmos is freed in Magic Crafters Home (gf2-17-4, gf3-18-2 'dragon 33 of 80') and again in Twilight Harbor (gf1-143-7, gf3-36-3 'Dragon 78/80 Cosmos').
